summary: Pacific Airport Group (GAP) filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of the business combination of Cross Border Xpress (CBX) and related technical assistance services. It also completed the purchase of the remaining 25% of CBX, now consolidating 100% ownership. As consideration, GAP issued 89,740,731 new shares, increasing total shares to 595,018,195. The merger was approved by shareholders and the agreement was notarized on April 30, 2026. No price per share or premium was disclosed. Financial consolidation begins in May 2026. Watch for integration risk and synergy realization.
